newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold year profits surge 39 percent.
newsitem.headline: Ahold year profits surge 39 percent.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV announced a 39 percent surge in 1996 net profits, bang in line with analysts' forecasts, and said the current year would see significant earnings per share growth.

Net profit in 1996 bounced up to 632.4 million guilders from 456.6 million in 1995, in line with forecasts from analysts of 611-641 million guilders. Turnover climbed to 36.54 billion guilders from the previous 29.62.
Fourth quarter net profit jumped to 216.3 million guilders from 132.9 million.
The company, which reports dividends in guilders and dollars, proposed payouts of 0.96 guilders and $0.43 compared to 0.88 guilders and $0.36 in 1995.
"The consolidated result after taxes will be considerably higher in 1997 than in 1996. Earnings per share will also show significant growth in 1997," the company said in statement with the results.
Ahold said it was also planning a three-for-one share split.
Shares in Ahold were 4.40 guilders higher at 136.60 guilders immediately after the results news.
